name: webapp-factory
description: Claude Code plugins to spec, plan, implement and review web applications (front, API, database) with a disciplined, reviewed workflow.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: The workflow: /factory:init scaffolds a project, then write-spec, write-plan, implement, grill-me and reviewer run the spec → plan → code → review → close loop, driven by the project's manifest.

plugins.name: factory-helper
plugins.description: Pane following the workflow: the current plan's timeline, the prompt of the next step, the sessions under way and a compliance score. Not implemented yet: see its README and .planning/features/factory-helper/.
